description: This file defines a static factory class for creating instances of Redis grain storage in an Orleans project. It contains a single method that constructs RedisGrainStorage objects using dependency injection and configuration options.

classes.name: RedisGrainStorageFactory
classes.description: A static factory class responsible for creating RedisGrainStorage instances within an Orleans application.
